name: freeCodeCamp Full Stack
description: A free, project-based curriculum covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and back-end basics.

name: Meta Front-End Developer
description: Covers React and front-end fundamentals, built by the team behind React itself.

name: Apple Developer Program
description: Required to publish apps to the App Store; includes access to Xcode cloud tools and TestFlight.

name: Google Associate Android Developer
description: Validates hands-on ability to build and debug a real Android app.

name: Google Data Analytics
description: No prior experience required — covers spreadsheets, SQL, and data visualization basics.

name: IBM Data Analyst
description: Similar scope to Google's, with more emphasis on Python and dashboarding tools.

name: IBM Data Science Professional Certificate
description: A step up from the analyst track — adds machine learning and applied statistics.

name: DeepLearning.AI ML Specialization
description: Andrew Ng's widely-used specialization covering core machine learning algorithms and math.

name: CompTIA Security+
description: The most commonly requested entry-level cybersecurity certification in job listings.

name: CompTIA Network+
description: Networking fundamentals — a common prerequisite before attempting Security+.

name: AWS Cloud Practitioner
description: The standard starting point for AWS certifications — broad, non-technical overview of cloud concepts.

name: AWS Solutions Architect Associate
description: Tests hands-on ability to design cost-effective, resilient systems on AWS.

name: Docker Certified Associate
description: Validates container fundamentals — image building, orchestration, and troubleshooting.

name: Google UX Design Certificate
description: Walks through the full design process, ending with a portfolio-ready case study.

name: Product School PM Certificate
description: A more structured, mentor-led option for people transitioning into product management.
